utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Faye just mentioned it's at the community center this Saturday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., not the garage. Let's update our plans.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's right, Opal! Thanks for catching that — the community center is definitely the spot this time, more space for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll see you there then. Should we meet by the front entrance around 9:45?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Quinn, what have you heard about the repair drive? I caught a few things from Vik and Rosa, but I'd love your take on it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's going to be great! This Saturday, everyone's fixing up old bikes and gear—I'm telling all the neighbors, and Cleo's even donating spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Bikes and spare parts? That's promising. I wish I had something to pitch in—maybe I can help with organizing or making coffee for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Rey! I just heard about the repair drive myself—Quinn's been telling everyone. You should come by Saturday, we could use all the hands we can get!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll try to make it. I've been sorting through my toolbox, might find something useful to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Rey! And don't worry if you don't have anything to bring—just showing up to help fix stuff is more than enough.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Hana! I was just asking about the repair drive. Do you know when it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still gathering the details, Oren. What have you heard about the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think Faye mentioned something about combining it with the kids' after-school pickup, but I'm not sure about the actual date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Opal! I could definitely use a hand with setting up tables and sorting donations. Could you come by around 9 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—fixing stuff! I was just thinking about my busted toaster. Can I bring that along?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, bring it! We'll have a station for small appliances, and I'm sure someone can take a look at your toaster.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, glad you're here! I've got a list of tools we'll need for the repair drive—could use your eyes on it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Gus. I'll take a look. It's good to have something to focus on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli. Here's the list—let me know if you spot anything we're missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I heard you were involved with that repair drive too—Gus mentioned he could use some help gathering supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you find the right socket for that bolt yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I didn't know about any bolt—I was just asking about the repair drive supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday's the day — we'll be at the community center from 8 to noon. I've got my tools ready and a list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard the Andersons are bringing their broken blender too—should be a good one to fix up!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, a blender should be a straightforward fix. I've already set aside my soldering iron for that day.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, I heard you're involved in the repair drive too. Need any help with planning or setup?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks Sam! I'm just helping spread the word and gathering a few tools. If you could bring some wrenches or bike tubes, that'd be great!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got plenty of wrenches and some spare bike tubes I can bring. Count me in!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just think we need to confirm the volunteer count before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Confirm the volunteer count? Who's been keeping track of that?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven't seen any sign-up sheet, that's exactly what worries me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, hey Leo—sorry I'm late. Did I miss any important updates for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nope, all set. Sam's coming over to help with tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, glad I didn't miss much. So what are we tackling first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's right, Bo—we're fixing up broken items instead of trashing them. You bring that toaster by on Saturday, and we'll see what we can do with it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive. I'll try to remember to swing by with that toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Bo! I'll keep an eye out for you and that toaster on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We're meeting at the community center parking lot at 8 AM sharp. I've got a list of accepted items if you want to check before hauling anything over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli. I'll check my list tonight and see if there's anything I can bring besides my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to hear it, Dane. Bring that toolbox for sure—we'll have a good crew for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Bo! I was just thinking—could we maybe set up a repair drop-off spot near the school pickup area on weekdays from 3 to 4:30?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, yeah, that sounds handy, I guess. I'm usually rushing through pickup, so I'd probably just drop stuff and go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Exactly, that's the idea — quick and easy, no extra trip needed. I'll make sure we have clear signs so you can just swing by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, got it running. Sam, bring your tools Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, sounds like we're all set for Saturday. I'll have my toolbox ready too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. 9 am at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I'm all set to help with the repair drive on Saturday. Need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! Just bring yourself and a willingness to help — we've got plenty of tools and supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there bright and early. Can't wait to pitch in!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Jules, that's a big help. Do you know anyone on Elm Street who might need extra assistance carrying things?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could help carry things for Mrs. Gable on Elm Street, if that's alright.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be wonderful, Uli—Mrs. Gable has trouble with her back, so she'd appreciate the help. Should I add you to the list for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Tess, you're right! It's going to be a big community effort—bikes, tools, you name it. Spread the word if you can!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, I just checked my shed—I've got a box of spare screws and some old tools I can bring to the drive!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Cleo! Every little bit helps—and don't forget to mention it to the folks on Maple Street too!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you find the right socket for that bolt yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still looking, but honestly, I'm more worried about whether we'll even have enough people to run this repair drive next weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So how many volunteers do we actually have lined up right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey, I saw you got that list from Gus—need me to grab any wrenches or nails while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I haven't seen any official notices posted anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's more of a neighbor-to-neighbor thing—Gus mentioned it at the store, and Eli's helping coordinate. I can fill you in on the details if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? We're collecting old tools and electronics to fix up and donate—I think the Andersons are bringing their broken blender!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh yeah, Hana roped me into spreading the word—I've been telling everyone on our block about it. Dane's even bringing his toolbox for the playground equipment!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Dane's already on it! I reminded him to bring that wrench he borrowed from Marty too. This weekend's going to be busy!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tess, I still can't remember the date for that repair drive — was it next Saturday or Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's Saturday, but don't quote me on that — maybe check with the organizers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday, got it — well, I'll double-check with Cleo just to be sure. Thanks, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's right, Noah! We're turning the yard sale into a repair drive too—folks can bring broken items, and we'll try to fix them together. Your toaster could be a perfect candidate!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a great idea. I've got a few old lamps that could use some fixing—maybe I'll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rey! Bring those lamps along—I've got some spare wiring and a multimeter ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it's in the garage at the corner of Maple and 3rd. Did you want to check it out together?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds like a good spot—I'd love to head over with you and see what they've got planned.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll grab my map so we don't miss any turns—let's meet at the mailbox in ten minutes.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
